## <i class="bi bi-cloud-download ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Database access

Data originally provided by:

- **Contact:** Samuel Abiven
- **Email:** [abiven@biotite.ens.fr](mailto:abiven@biotite.ens.fr)
- **Original source:** <https://zenodo.org/records/5675793>

**Available files**

| Type | Filename | Link |
|------|----------|------|
| MIR spectra — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/WS_SWIND/ossl_mir_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| MIR spectra — Parquet | `ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/WS_SWIND/ossl_mir_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil lab measurements — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/WS_SWIND/ossl_soillab_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| Soil lab measurements — Parquet | `ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/WS_SWIND/ossl_soillab_v1.3.parquet) |
| Soil site metadata — CSV (gzip) | `ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/WS_SWIND/ossl_soilsite_v1.3.csv.gz) |
| Soil site metadata — Parquet | `ossl_soilsite_v1.3.parquet` | [Download](https://storage.googleapis.com/soilspec4gg-public/datasets/WS_SWIND/ossl_soilsite_v1.3.parquet) |

## <i class="bi bi-pin-map ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil site information

- **Coordinates precision:** none
- **Sampling depth:** various
- **Geography:** none
- **Variables available (OSSL):** 6 out of 6 — see [Database description](../db-desc.html#panel-soilsite) for full schema
- **Populated columns:** `id.layer_uuid_txt`, `id.layer_local_c`, `site.id_src_txt`, `site.pit_src_txt`, `layer.upper.depth_usda_cm`, `layer.lower.depth_usda_cm`

## <i class="bi bi-clipboard-data ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> Soil laboratory information

- **Total samples:** 189
- **Properties available (original):** 20
- **Properties standardized (OSSL):** 17 — summarized in **@tbl-soillab-ws_swind** below
- **Categories:** physical, chemical, carbon & nutrients, metal elements
- **Original source:** see [Database access](#database-access)

## <i class="bi bi-soundwave ossl-section-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i> MIR

- **Acquisition mode:** Not available
- **Intensity:** BC-absorbance
- **Original range:** 400-4000
- **Standardized range:** 600-4000
- **Instrument:** TENSOR 27 Spectrophotometer
- **Manufacturer:** Bruker (Switzerland)
- **Scan accessory:** Not available
- **Sample preparation:** Sieved<2mm
- **Additional info:** Atmospheric variations were integrated by running a potassium bromide background calibration.
